children.name: Ophiocoma erinaceus
children.description: Ophiocoma erinaceus is an echinoderm, more specifically a brittle star of the Ophiocomidae family.

children.name: Ophiocoma scolopendrina
children.description: Ophiocoma scolopendrina is a species of brittle star belonging to the family Ophiocomidae.

children.name: Ophiocoma echinata
children.description: Ophiocoma echinata, the spiny ophiocoma, is a species of brittle star belonging to the family Ophiocomidae.

children.name: Ophiocomella alexandri
children.description: Ophiocomella alexandri, known as Alexander's spiny brittle star or banded brittle star, is a species of marine brittle star.

children.name: Ophiomastix venosa
children.description: Ophiomastix venosa is a species of brittle star commonly found inhabiting Indo-Pacific shallow, coastal waters.

children.name: Ophiomastix wendtii
children.description: Ophiomastix wendtii, also known by its common name, the red ophiocoma, and formerly as Ophiocoma wendtii, is a species of brittle stars that inhabits coral reefs from Bermuda to Brazil, primarily in the Caribbean sea.

children.name: Breviturma pica
children.description: Breviturma pica, the yellow-spotted brittle star, is a species of brittle star in the family Ophiocomidae.

children.name: Ophiocomina nigra
children.description: Ophiocomina nigra, commonly known as the black brittle star or black serpent star, is a species of marine invertebrate in the order Ophiurida.
